chunks: It is narrated from the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, that he said:
"The reward of hajj is Paradise, and the 'umrah is an expiation for every sin, and the best 'umrah is the 'umrah of Rajab."

key_terms.الْجَنَّةُ: Paradise, the promised reward for hajj
key_terms.الْحَجَّةُ: The pilgrimage whose reward is described here as Paradise
key_terms.الْعُمْرَةُ: The minor pilgrimage, described here as expiation for sins
key_terms.ثَوَابُهَا: Its reward and recompense from Allah
key_terms.ذَنْبٍ: A sin or act of disobedience
key_terms.رَجَبٍ: The sacred month in which 'umrah is described as most excellent
key_terms.كَفَّارَةُ: That which wipes away or expiates sins

ai.seo_question: What is the reward of hajj and what is the best time for performing 'umrah?
ai.summary: This hadith highlights the immense merit of hajj and 'umrah. It states that hajj leads to Paradise, that 'umrah serves as an expiation for sins, and that performing 'umrah in Rajab holds special excellence.
